plot-widget-config.description: What one profile, analysis or statistics widget shows: which image and region, and what it shows of them

imageId.description: Workspace ID of the image the widget shows, when it is not the active one

regions.description: The region the widget shows of an image, by the ID the region was saved with. An entry with no image is for the active image

stokes.description: Spatial profiler widgets: the Stokes the profile is taken in, when it is not the image's current one

coordinate.description: Histogram and statistics widgets: the Stokes they are taken in

profileCategory.description: Spectral profiler widgets: what several profiles shown together differ in

imageIds.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the images whose profiles are shown together, by workspace image ID

regionIds.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the regions whose profiles are shown, by the IDs they were saved with

statsTypes.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the statistics whose profiles are shown

coordinates.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the Stokes whose profiles are shown

profileColors.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the colour of each profile shown together, by what it is the profile of

intensityUnit.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the unit profiles of several images are shown in together

restFrameRedshift.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the source's redshift

fitting.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the fitting function, the continuum and the initial guesses. The fit results are not saved

function.description: The fitting function: 0 is Gaussian and 1 is Lorentzian

continuum.description: The order of the continuum: -1 is none, 0 is constant and 1 is linear

components.description: The initial guesses of each component

xUnit.description: The spectral coordinate the guesses are in, such as "Frequency (GHz), LSRK, rest frame"

yUnit.description: The unit of the y axis the guesses are in, such as "Jy/beam"

moments.description: Spectral profiler widgets: the moment generator settings
The selected moments, as CARTA.Moment values

regionId.description: The region the moments are made from, by the ID it was saved with; -1 is the whole image and -3 the active region

channelRange.description: The spectral range, in the units of channelUnit; left out when it is the whole spectral axis

channelUnit.description: The spectral coordinate of channelRange, such as "Frequency (GHz), LSRK"

mask.description: The mask, as a CARTA.MomentMask value: 0 is none, 1 keeps and 2 leaves out the pixels in maskRange

maskRange.description: The range of pixel values the mask uses, in the units of maskUnit; left out when it is 0 to 1

maskUnit.description: The unit of maskRange, such as "Jy/beam"

minX.description: Line plot widgets: the range the plot was zoomed to, in the units it was shown in

pixelBounds.description: Histogram widgets: the pixel values the histogram is computed between, when they are not the image's own

ranges.description: Stokes analysis widgets: the bounds its plots were zoomed to

catalog-widget-config.description: What one catalog table or plot widget shows. A table widget records its catalog and settings sections; a plot widget records its catalog and what it is drawn from

type.description: The kind of widget, which a restore needs to recreate one the layout does not have

catalogId.description: Workspace ID of the catalog the widget shows

settingsTabs.description: Table widgets: the settings section each catalog was left on, keyed by the workspace's ID for that catalog

isFittingEnabled.description: Plot widgets: whether a linear fit is drawn. The fit is recomputed from the rows the plot shows

cursor.description: Plot widgets: the values the cursor last read off the plot, as a scatter point or a histogram bin's center and count

thresholdOption.description: The polarization the threshold is applied to: total intensity (I, 1) or linearly polarized intensity (Plinear, 14).

spatial.description: ID of the spatial reference file

spectral.description: ID of the spectral reference file

raster.description: ID of the raster reference file

lineRegionSampleWidth.description: Line and polyline regions: how many pixels wide a spatial profile along the region samples

opacity.description: How opaque the region is drawn: 1 shown, 0.5 semi-transparent, 0 hidden; left out when shown

center.description: The center coordinates of the viewport

zoomLevel.description: The zoom level of the viewport

spectralCoordinate.description: The spectral coordinate the spectral axis is shown in, as the spectral settings name it

spectralCoordinateSecondary.description: The secondary spectral coordinate, as the spectral settings name it

spectralSystem.description: The spectral reference frame the spectral axis is shown in

intensityUnit.description: The unit a spectral profile of the image shows its intensity in

restFrequency.description: The rest frequency the spectral axis is converted with, when it is not the one in the header

restFrame.description: The rest frame the spectral axis of an image that supports one is shown in

beam.description: How the beam is drawn over an image that has one

titleCustomText.description: The custom title of the image in the WCS overlay, left out when it is the file name

colorbarLabelCustomText.description: The custom label of the colorbar of the image, left out when it is the default label

offsetCoordinates.description: Offset coordinates, when shown on an image not matched to another: their centre in image pixels, and whether it is the origin (0) or the pole (1)

generated-file.description: An image a request made: shown as a file is, but made again rather than opened, so it has no source

name.description: The name the image had when it was saved, for naming it to the user

moment.description: For a moment image, which of the request's moments it is, as a CARTA.Moment value

generation-request.description: How generated images were made, naming images and regions by the IDs the workspace knows them by

sourceImageId.description: The image the moments are taken of

regionId.description: The region they are taken over, by the ID it was saved with; the whole image when it is not a region of its own

moments.description: The moments made, as CARTA.Moment values

channelRange.description: The channels the moments are taken over, as channel indices

mask.description: How the pixel range masks the cube, as a CARTA.MomentMask value

sourceImageId.description: The image the cut is made through

regionId.description: The line or polyline region the cut follows, by the ID it was saved with

width.description: How many pixels wide the cut is averaged over

channelRange.description: The channels the PV image covers, as channel indices; all of them when left out

reverse.description: Whether the position axis is drawn vertically

object.description: The object the image is centred on, or else its centre

fov.description: The field of view, in degrees

generated-images.description: One request that made images, recorded once however many it made, and the images it made that the session still showed

titleCustomText.description: The custom title of the color-blended image, left out when it is the default title

image-source.description: How the image is opened again

catalog-table-config.description: Which rows and columns a catalog holds, and how its table shows them

loadedRows.description: File catalogs: how many rows of the table's query were loaded, by scrolling the table or plotting the catalog, which its plots are drawn from. Online catalogs hold all of their rows

scrollPosition.description: Where the table was scrolled to, in pixels from its top left

imageOverlay.description: The overlay drawn over the image, independent of the current plot and coordinate controls

system.description: The system the overlay's positions were read in when it was drawn

catalog-source.description: How the catalog is loaded again

table.description: VizieR only: the table the catalog came from

keywords.description: VizieR only: the keywords the table search was narrowed by

id.description: Stable ID of the catalog within this workspace

coordinateSystem.description: How the catalog's position columns are to be read

associatedImageId.description: ID of the image the catalog is overlaid on

rowCount.description: How many rows the catalog held when it was saved

contentHash.description: Fingerprint of the rows an online catalog held when it was saved

name.description: Optional workspace name. Filename will be used if this is missing

frontendVersion.description: The version of the frontend targeted by this workspace

generatedImages.description: The moment, PV and HiPS images, by the requests that made them, in an order each can be made again in: a request can be made of an image an earlier one made

selectedFile.description: ID of the currently active file

selectedColorBlending.description: The color-blended image in front, when it is one, by the imageListIndex its entry in colorBlendingImages carries. selectedFile then names the image it is blended onto

catalogWidgets.description: What each catalog table and plot widget shows, keyed by the widget's own stable ID

plotWidgets.description: What each profile, analysis and statistics widget shows, keyed by the widget's own stable ID

wcsOverlay.description: The custom texts of the WCS overlay that are the same for every image, and the switches that show the custom texts. The layout keeps how the overlay looks

layout.description: The arrangement the workspace was saved in, in the form a saved layout takes

thumbnail.description: A data URL containing a base64-encoded JPEG

date.description: The modification date as a unix timestamp

shared.description: Whether the workspace is shared between multiple users
